description: SCENARIO: You're about to start a remote pair programming session with a junior developer in 5 minutes. They'll be watching your screen while you debug together. TASKS: (1) Open the workspace at /home/ga/workspace/pair_session in VSCode. (2) Modify VSCode settings to increase editor.fontSize to 18 or larger (for screen share readability). (3) Enable editor.renderWhitespace (set to 'all', 'boundary', 'selection', or 'trailing' - NOT 'none'). (4) Ensure editor.lineNumbers is visible (should be 'on', 'relative', or 'interval' - NOT 'off'). (5) Create a file named 'session_notes.txt' in the /home/ga/workspace/pair_session directory containing: your name as session lead, today's date, what settings you changed for the session, and a note that the workspace is ready for collaborative debugging. TIP: You can modify settings via Settings UI (Ctrl+,) or edit settings.json directly. Settings are in /home/ga/.config/Code/User/settings.json
